parole.testo: First known occurrence of the expression in the Czech language (16th century) was in the sense side (of a gutter or hole). From early Middle High German bord, bort ("side", especially of a ship; originally "a board", "a plank"). This comes from Proto-Indo-European *bʰerH- (“cut”).
Inherited from Old Czech špeh, which derived from Middle High German spëhen (“to spy”), ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *speḱ- (“to look”).
